At Middle Tennessee Chiropractic, Dr. Alex Vear strives to deliver excellence in natural, drug-free healthcare by listening to the concerns of each patient. People seeking treatment for chronic pain management, sports injury, or other physical therapy needs will receive personalized, effective care at our comfortably appointed chiropractic clinic. 

Understanding the needs of our patients also means creating wellness plans that are affordable for families and individuals of all ages. Dr. Vear's unique practice is happy to treat family pets and also specializes in equine chiropractic care and massage. For more information on how Middle Tennessee Chiropractic can help you and your family experience better health, call or visit our website today!
